For a successful crowdfunding campaign, promoting it is necessary. You should consider making a video. This allows investors to get to know you and learn about your product. In the video, describe your situation clearly and show your product. You also need to express how (C) [important / importantly] the product is to you. Don't forget to include a direct request for support at the end. During a campaign, it is important to send investors updates every week. Through the update, the investors will be able to track the progress of the campaign.
options: ① because ...... to set ...... important
② because ...... setting ...... importantly
③ because ...... setting ...... important
④ because of ...... setting ...... importantly
⑤ because of ...... to set ...... important
questions.explanation: (A) 뒤에 주어(your potential investors)와 동사(will want)가 포함된 절이 오므로 접속사 because가 적절합니다. (B) '할 것을 기억하다(미래지향)'는 의미이므로 remember to set이 적절합니다 (setting은 과거에 했던 것을 기억하다는 뜻). (C) how 형용사/부사 구문에서 본래 'The product is important'라는 형용사 보어 자리였으므로 important가 적절합니다.

questions.question: 23. (A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.4점]
questions.passage: By improving accessibility of the workplace for workers that are typically at a disadvantage in the labour market, AI can improve (A)[ equity / exclusiveness ] in the workplace. AI-powered assistive devices to aid workers with visual, speech or hearing difficulties are becoming more widespread, improving the access to, and the quality of work for people with disabilities. For example, speech recognition solutions for people with dysarthric voices, or live captioning systems for deaf and hard of hearing people can facilitate communication with colleagues and access to jobs where inter-personal communication is (B)[ essential / optional ]. AI can also enhance the capabilities of low-skilled workers, with potentially positive effects on their wages and career prospects. For example, AI's capacity to (C)[ interpret / paraphrase ] written and spoken word in real-time can improve the performance of non-native speakers in the workplace. Moreover, recent developments in AI-powered text generators can instantly improve the performance of lower-skilled individuals in domains such as writing, coding or customer service.
options: ① exclusiveness .... optional .... paraphrase
② exclusiveness .... optional .... interpret
③ exclusiveness .... essential .... paraphrase
④ equity .... essential .... paraphrase
⑤ equity .... essential .... interpret
questions.explanation: (A) AI를 통해 노동 시장에서 불리한 위치에 있는 노동자들의 접근성을 높이므로 '⑤ equity(형평 또는 공정)'가 적절함. (B) 청각 장애인 등에게 도움을 주는 시스템은 대인 소통이 '⑤ essential(필수적인)' 직무에서 유용함. (C) 비모국어 화자의 성과를 높이는 것은 실시간 통역/해석이므로 '⑤ interpret(해석하다)'가 적절함.
options_translation: ① 배타성 .... 선택적인 .... 바꾸어 표현하다
② 배타성 .... 선택적인 .... 해석하다
③ 배타성 .... 필수적인 .... 바꾸어 표현하다
④ 형평 .... 필수적인 .... 바꾸어 표현하다
⑤ 형평 .... 필수적인 .... 해석하다

questions.question: 24. 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage: Routines enable athletes to evaluate competition conditions. For example, bouncing a ball in a volleyball service routine supplies the server with information about the ball, the floor, and the state of her muscles. This information can then be used to properly prepare for her serve. Routines also enable athletes to adjust and fine-tune their preparations based on those evaluations or in pursuit of a particular competitive goal. This adaptation can involve adjustment to the conditions, rivals, competitive situation, or internal influences that can affect performance. Just like adjusting a race-car engine to the conditions of the track, air temperature, and weather, routines adjust all competitive components to achieve proper performance.
options: ① the function of preparation rituals in optimizing athletic output
② external conditions that pose difficulties for athletes in competition
③ the significance of muscular power in achieving athletic excellence
④ cognitive strategies employed by athletes to maintain concentration
⑤ the impact of competitors on athletes' performance during contests
questions.explanation: 이 글은 선수들의 'routine(루틴)'이 경기 조건을 평가하고 그에 맞게 준비를 조절하여 최적의 수행(성과)을 내는 데 도움을 준다는 내용이므로, ① '운동 성과 최적화에 있어서 준비 의식(루틴)의 기능'이 가장 적절한 주제이다.
options_translation: ① 운동 성과 최적화에 있어서 준비 의식의 기능
② 경기 중 선수들에게 어려움을 제기하는 외부 조건들
③ 운동적 우수성 달성에 있어 근력의 중요성
④ 집중을 유지하기 위해 선수들에 의해 채택된 인지적 전략들
⑤ 경기 중 선수의 성과에 미치는 경쟁자의 영향

questions.question: 25. 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.3점]
questions.passage: Plato argued that when you see something that strikes you as beautiful, you are really just seeing a partial reflection of true beauty, just as a painting or even a photograph only captures part of the real thing. True beauty, or what Plato calls the Form of Beauty, has no particular color, shape, or size. Rather, it is an abstract idea, like the number five. You can make drawings of the number five in blue or red ink, big or small, but the number five itself is none of those things. It has no physical form. Think of the idea of a triangle, for example. Although it has no particular color or size, it somehow lies within each and every triangle you see. Plato thought the same was true of beauty. The Form of Beauty somehow lies within each and every beautiful thing you see.
options: ① Sensory beauty is based on physically existing objects.
② True beauty is a concept defined individually through emotion.
③ We can better understand beauty by conceptualizing it visually.
④ Beauty does not belong to individual traits but to an abstract idea.
⑤ Plato believed that true beauty could be captured through artworks.
questions.explanation: 플라톤은 진정한 아름다움이 물질적인 형태(색, 모양, 크기)가 아닌 추상적인 관념(이데아)에 있다고 주장했다. ④ '아름다움은 개별적 특성에 속하는 것이 아닌 추상적 관념에 속한다'는 내용이 요지로 가장 적절하다.
options_translation: ① 감각적 아름다움은 물질적으로 존재하는 대상에 기반을 둔다.
② 진정한 아름다움은 감정을 통해 개별적으로 정의되는 개념이다.
③ 우리는 시각적으로 개념화함으로써 아름다움을 더 잘 이해할 수 있다.
④ 아름다움은 개별적 특성에 속하는 것이 아닌 추상적 관념에 속한다.
⑤ 플라톤은 진정한 아름다움이 예술 작품을 통해 포착될 수 있다고 믿었다.

questions.question: 26. 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은? [3.6점]
questions.passage: Our skin conducts electricity more or less efficiently, depending on our emotions. We know that when we're emotionally stimulated-stressed, sad, any intense emotion, really-our bodies sweat a tiny bit, so little we might not even notice. And when those tiny drops of sweat appear, our skin gets more electrically ① <u>responsive</u>. This change in sweat gland activity happens completely without your conscious mind having much ② <u>control</u> in the matter. If you feel emotionally intense, you're likely to ③ <u>detect</u> an increase in sweat gland activity. This is particularly ④ <u>meaningful</u> from a scientific viewpoint, because it allows us to put an objective value on a subjective state of mind. We can actually measure your emotional state by tracking how your body subconsciously sweats, by running a bit of electricity through your skin. We can then ⑤ <u>integrate</u> subconscious experience of emotional intensity into an objective number by figuring out how good your skin gets at transferring an electrical current.
options: ① responsive
② control
③ detect
④ meaningful
⑤ integrate
questions.explanation: 글의 앞부분에서 땀샘 활동의 변화는 의식적인 마음의 통제 없이 일어나며, 너무 미세해서 우리가 인지(notice)하지 못할 수도 있다고 설명했습니다. 따라서 감정이 격해질 때 땀샘 활동의 증가가 '유발(trigger)'되는 것이지, 스스로 그 미세한 변화를 '③ detect(감지하다)' 하기는 어렵습니다. 문맥상 ③은 'trigger'나 'experience' 등으로 바뀌는 것이 적절합니다.
options_translation: ① 반응하는
② 통제
③ 감지하다
④ 의미 있는
⑤ 통합하다

questions.question: 28. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.5점]
questions.passage: Working around the whole painting, rather than concentrating on one area at a time, will mean you can stop at any point and the painting can be considered "finished." Artists often find it difficult to know when to stop painting, and it can be tempting to keep on adding more to your work. It is important to take a few steps back from the painting from time to time to assess your progress. Putting too much into a painting can spoil its impact and leave it looking overworked. If you find yourself struggling to decide whether you have finished, take a break and come back to it later with fresh eyes. Then ________________________________________________.
options: ① you can evaluate if certain parts of your painting need more fine-tuning
② it's important to start a new piece to avoid overworking the current one
③ you should immediately add more detail to enhance visual interest
④ you can compare your work to other artists' styles for inspiration
⑤ it's best to repaint sections that look too plain or unfinished
questions.explanation: 본문은 그림이 완성되었는지, 혹은 특정 부분에 더 많은 작업(미세 조정)이 필요한지 결정하기 위해 휴식을 취하고 '새로운 눈(fresh eyes)'으로 그림을 다시 볼 것을 권장하고 있습니다. 따라서 빈칸에는 휴식 후 자신의 작품을 객관적으로 평가할 수 있다는 내용인 ①번이 가장 적절합니다.
options_translation: ① 그림의 특정 부분이 더 세밀한 조정이 필요한지 평가할 수 있다.
② 현재 작품의 과도한 작업을 피하기 위해 새 작품을 시작하는 것이 중요하다.
③ 시각적 흥미를 높이기 위해 즉시 더 많은 세부 사항을 추가해야 한다.
④ 영감을 얻기 위해 다른 작가들의 스타일과 자신의 작품을 비교할 수 있다.
⑤ 너무 평범하거나 미완성으로 보이는 부분을 다시 그리는 것이 가장 좋다.

questions.question: 29. 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.7점]
questions.passage: Kids tire of their toys, college students get sick of cafeteria food, and sooner or later most of us lose interest in our favorite TV shows.
ordered_passages: (A) The bottom line is that we humans are easily bored. But why should this be true? The answer lies buried deep in our nerve cells, which are designed to reduce their initial excited response to stimuli each time they occur.

(B) Boredom in reaction to an unchanging environment turns down the level of neural excitation so that new stimuli (like our ancestor's hypothetical puma threat) stand out more. This system helps us focus on things that could be important for our safety or survival.

(C) At the same time, these neurons enhance their responses to things that change — especially things that change quickly. We probably evolved this way because our ancestors got more survival value, for example, from attending to what was moving in a tree (such as a puma) than to the tree itself.
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장은 사람들이 쉽게 흥미를 잃고 지루해하는 사례들을 제시합니다. (A)는 이를 '인간은 쉽게 지루해한다'고 요약하며 그 이유가 자극에 대한 반응을 줄이도록 설계된 '신경 세포'에 있다고 설명합니다. (C)는 '이와 동시에'라는 연결어를 사용하여 변화하는 것(예: 퓨마)에 대해서는 신경 세포가 반응을 강화한다는 점을 언급합니다. 마지막으로 (B)에서 이러한 시스템(지루함을 통해 새로운 자극을 돋보이게 하는 것)이 인류의 안전과 생존에 어떻게 도움이 되었는지 결론지으며 마무리하는 것이 가장 자연스럽습니다.

questions.question: 30. 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.5점]
questions.passage: We think we are shaping our buildings. But really, our buildings and development are also shaping us.
ordered_passages: (A) This is an early example of a society constructing something that ends up radically remaking the society itself. Things are not so different in our own time.
(B) Before these ancestors erected standing stones some 12,000 years ago, they were hunter-gatherers. Completing the structures required many generations, which seems to have led them to settle down.
(C) One of the best examples of this is the oldest-known construction: the ornately carved rings of standing stones at Göbekli Tepe in Turkey.
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장은 '우리가 건물을 만들지만, 건물 또한 우리를 형성한다'는 핵심 아이디어를 도입합니다. (C)에서 이에 대한 구체적인 예시로 터키의 괴베클리 테페(Göbekli Tepe)를 언급합니다. (B)에서는 이 건축물을 짓기 위해 수렵 채집인이었던 조상들이 여러 세대에 걸쳐 공사를 진행하며 정착 생활을 하게 된 과정을 설명합니다. 마지막으로 (A)에서 이것이 건축을 통해 사회 자체가 근본적으로 재구성된 초기 사례임을 요약하며 현대 사회와의 연결성을 언급하는 것이 가장 자연스러운 흐름입니다.

questions.question: 1. 다음 글의 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.3점]
questions.passage:
Dear Community Member,
Thank you for showing interest in our upcoming event. We're excited to invite you to our Sock DIY Workshop, where people of all ages can enjoy making creative sock crafts together. The workshop will take place on Saturday, April 19th, from 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. at the community hall, Clanton Center. Please remember to bring your own used but clean socks for the activity. The participation fee is $5 per person, which covers all the materials you'll need. If you would like to know more details about the program, feel free to visit our website or contact us at 555-123-4567. We hope to see you there!
Sincerely,
Clanton Center Team
options: ① To inform about a DIY workshop
② To display a participant's past craftworks
③ To offer a refund for the participation fee
④ To advertise a campaign for donating used socks
⑤ To explain the safety evacuation plan on the day of the workshop
questions.explanation: 글의 서두에서 'Sock DIY Workshop'에 초대하고 있으며, 시간, 장소, 준비물, 참가비 등 구체적인 정보를 안내하고 있으므로 DIY 워크숍에 대해 알리는 것이 목적입니다.
options_translation: ① DIY 워크숍에 대해 알리기 위해
② 참가자의 과거 공예 작품을 전시하기 위해
③ 참가비 환불을 제안하기 위해
④ 중고 양말 기부 캠페인을 광고하기 위해
⑤ 워크숍 당일의 안전 대피 계획을 설명하기 위해

questions.question: 2. 다음 글에 드러난 'David'의 심경 변화로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.4점]
questions.passage: David, a chef and kitchen manager, has been writing morning pages for two years. "At first," he says, "I mostly wrote complaints about my stressful life. But later, I started asking questions like 'What would make my life easier today?' or 'How can I improve my recipes?' Sometimes, I keep asking questions until I experience a kind of 'click moment' - like a door opening to new ideas. Now I feel less stressed, enjoy my job more, and work more productively."
options: ① jealous - confident
② distressed - envious
③ satisfied - impatient
④ frustrated - motivated
⑤ confused - discouraged
questions.explanation: 초기에는 스트레스가 많은 삶에 대해 불평(complaints)을 썼으나(좌절된 상태), 이후 새로운 아이디어가 떠오르는 경험을 하며 현재는 업무를 더 즐기고 생산적으로 일하게 되었다(동기부여된 상태)는 내용입니다.
options_translation: ① 질투하는 - 자신감 있는
② 고통스러운 - 부러워하는
③ 만족스러운 - 조바심 내는
④ 좌절한 - 동기부여된
⑤ 혼란스러운 - 낙담한

questions.question: 3. 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.6점]
questions.passage: Our knowledge about the octopus is still very limited. Thanks to the efforts of scientists, however, it is expanding year by year. One of the most impressive new findings about the octopus is that it seems to have feelings. Of course, it is impossible for us to know exactly what they feel, but a few of their changes in skin color seem to be linked to their feelings. For example, a giant Pacific octopus that turns red seems to be excited, while it is white when it is relaxed. An octopus presented with a difficult puzzle often undergoes several rapid changes in color. The octopus seems to be worried that it may not solve the problem.
options: ① The link between skin color and emotion in octopuses
② The role of color change in octopus communication
③ The expansion of scientific research on octopuses
④ The behavioral patterns of intelligent octopuses
⑤ The causes of stress in giant Pacific octopuses
questions.explanation: 문어의 피부 색깔 변화가 그들의 감정(흥분, 이완, 걱정 등)과 연관되어 있다는 것이 글의 핵심 내용입니다.
options_translation: ① 문어의 피부색과 감정 사이의 연관성
② 문어의 의사소통에서 색 변화의 역할
③ 문어에 대한 과학적 연구의 확장
④ 지능적인 문어의 행동 패턴
⑤ 대왕문어의 스트레스 원인

questions.question: 4. 다음 글에서 필자가 주장하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.3점]
questions.passage: Plato argued that when you see something that strikes you as beautiful, you are really just seeing a partial reflection of true beauty, just as a painting or even a photograph only captures part of the real thing. True beauty, or what Plato calls the Form of Beauty, has no particular color, shape, or size. Rather, it is an abstract idea, like the number five. You can make drawings of the number five in blue or red ink, big or small, but the number five itself is none of those things. It has no physical form. Think of the idea of a triangle, for example. Although it has no particular color or size, it somehow lies within each and every triangle you see. This perspective reveals something essential about the way we perceive beauty in the world. What we often admire as beautiful is not the ultimate standard, but only a pale, incomplete imitation of something far greater and more perfect. We must recognize that the beauty we encounter in everyday life, no matter how striking, is fundamentally limited and superficial compared to the ideal.
options: ① 세상의 아름다움은 모두 같은 가치를 지니고 있다.
② 이상적인 아름다움은 인간의 감정에 의해 결정된다.
③ 아름다움에 대한 감상은 시대와 문화에 따라 달라진다.
④ 아름다움을 감상할 때는 다양한 관점을 존중해야 한다.
⑤ 우리가 보는 아름다움은 진정한 아름다움의 불완전한 모사일 뿐이다.
questions.explanation: 플라톤은 우리가 일상에서 마주하는 아름다움은 진정한 아름다움(Form of Beauty)의 부분적인 반영이자 불완전한 모방일 뿐이라고 주장하고 있습니다. 따라서 정답은 ⑤번입니다.

questions.question: 5. 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은? [3.7점]
questions.passage: Promotion deals with consumer psychology. We can't force people to think one way or another, and the clever marketer knows that promotion is used to provide information in the most clear, honest, and simple fashion possible. By doing so, the possibility of increasing sales goes up. Gone are the days when promotions were done in order to fool the consumer into purchasing something. The long term effect of getting a consumer to buy something they did not really want or need wasn't good. In fact, consumers fooled once can do damage to sales as they relate their experience to others. Instead, marketers now know that their goal is to identify the consumers who are most likely to appreciate a good or service, and to promote that good or service in a way that makes the value clear to the consumer. Therefore, marketers must know where the potential consumers are, and how to reach them.
options: ① Clever Tricks to Fool Modern Consumers
② Defining Marketing Ethics to Frustrate Competitors
③ Why Frequent Advertising Decreases Consumer Interest
④ The Role of Finance in Modern Advertising Campaigns
⑤ Honest Promotion: A Secure Way to Generate Long-Term Trust
questions.explanation: 지문은 소비자를 속이는 마케팅의 부정적 영향과 정직하고 명확하게 정보를 제공하여 가치를 전달하는 마케팅의 중요성을 강조하고 있습니다. 따라서 정직한 홍보가 장기적인 신뢰를 구축하는 방법임을 나타내는 ⑤번이 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question: 8. 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은? [3.7점]
questions.passage: Our skin conducts electricity more or less efficiently, depending on our emotions. When intense emotions such as stress or sadness occur, our bodies naturally consume a tiny amount of energy to activate sweat glands, producing drops so small we might not even notice. As these appear, our skin's ability to conduct electricity increases. This change happens without conscious control, simply as a response to how we feel. Scientists can engage with this reaction by running a mild electrical current through the skin, observing how the conductivity shifts. As emotional intensity rises, sweat gland activity increases, while calm states cause it to decrease. This reaction allows researchers to reveal an objective measurement for a deeply subjective state of mind, translating emotions into precise numerical data through the skin's natural response.

questions.question: 9. 다음 습관 형성에 관한 안내문의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은? [3.5점]
questions.passage:
Want to build a new habit that really sticks?
Try these five helpful tips:

Start Small
Set a simple goal. Don't try to change everything at once. Small steps are easier to repeat and build into a routine.

Be Clear
Be specific about your goal. Instead of "I'll read more," try "I'll read for 10 minutes after dinner."

Use a Trigger
Connect your new habit to something you already do. For example, after brushing your teeth, you can begin your new routine.

Make it Fun
Link your habit to something you enjoy. Listening to music while doing the habit can help make it more enjoyable.

Stay Flexible
Don't worry if you miss a day. Just continue when you can. Building habits takes time and patience.
options: ① 작은 목표로 시작하는 것이 반복하기 쉽다.
② 구체적인 목표가 습관 형성에 도움이 된다.
③ 새로운 습관을 기존의 행동과 연결할 수 있다.
④ 좋아하는 활동과 함께하면 습관 형성이 쉬워진다.

questions.question: 17. 다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은? [3.5점]
questions.passage: The morning pages are a daily exercise in which you write three pages of anything that comes to your mind. ① Many people find that writing in this way helps them clarify their thoughts and reduce anxiety. ② Originally, this technique was designed to help artists and writers break through creative blocks. ③ It focuses more on the process than the result, allowing people to explore their minds freely. ④ Because the goal is to improve writing skills, users are advised to revise their pages every week. ⑤ In fact, some people report unexpected benefits such as making better decisions or identifying what truly matters to them.
